verdict.rationale: Auto-enrichment is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence never mentions enriching contact or company records with firmographic or contact data from any source. The closest claim, AI agents that 'update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously,' describes record automation, not data enrichment, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
